android.desc:
Take charge of a giant robotic snake and smash through cities with ease as you fight to create the most fearsome weapon of all time.  
 
Your objective is simple: DESTROY EVERYTHING! 
 
Unleash the power of Colossatron! A unique combination of Match 3 and Snake gameplay allows you to build a devastating machine by merging colored power ups to create new and more powerful weapons. With thousands of potential combinations, the key to victory lies in mastering the art of building Colossatron to take down formidable bosses. 
  
FEATURES: 
● Chaotic Campaign – Explode your way through seven continents on a destructive trail spanning the entire globe! 
● Uninterrupted gameplay without ads or in-app purchases
● Epic Boss Fights – Throw down against giant mechs, ballistic gunships and more in a furious fight for survival! 
● Devastating Weaponry – Crush your enemies with a huge arsenal of powerful weapons, impressive upgrades, and high-tech gadgets 
● Intense Survival Challenges – Compete against friends in the ultimate test of skill and strategy 
 
“All in all, Colossatron just further shows Halfbrick’s mastery over mobile games.” - GameFreaks 

“It delivers that same satisfaction you get from finding a perfect match in Candy Crush, but in a completely different way.” - GameZebo 

“Halfbrick has come up with a puzzling, action-packed way to help Colossatron complete his mission of world domination.” - Touch Arcade  

Colossatron is fast, fun and non-stop action. The battle starts NOW! 
 
WHAT'S HALFBRICK+

Halfbrick+ is a mobile games subscription service featuring:

● Exclusive access to the highest-rated games
● No ads or in app purchases
● Brought to you by the makers of Award-winning mobile games

● Curated by hand - for gamers by gamers!
